messages:
Sam: heads up — my cat launched an amphibious assault on my desk. Lamp + ethernet switch = oof. Posting pic: https://i.imgur.com/abcd1234.jpg :scream_cat:
Maya: omg :joy: please tell the cat is ok
Sam: cat is fine, lamp not fine. Router blinked twice then died. temporarily on phone hotspot.
Jonah: been there. ps I keep a spare mini switch in the closet for this exact scenario. also velcro power strips.
Priya: same. plant knocked a surge protector off once, pancake chaos. tip: command to restart network on mac: `sudo ifconfig en0 down && sudo ifconfig en0 up`
Miguel: if hotspot isn't stable, try `nmcli device wifi hotspot ifname wlan0 ssid RedwoodTemp password hunter2` (linux) — works in a pinch
Zoe: @Sam love the cat pic. did you name it 'reboot' now?
Sam: haha no, 'buffer'. also OpsBot canceled my infra deploy :rotating_light: — OpsBot: 'Deploy halted for user Sam due to detected network instability (source: CI runner)'.
Maya: :thumbsup: safe to postpone. also vote: who keeps spare cables? raise hand emoji
Jonah: raises hand 🙋‍♂️
Priya: me too
Miguel: I have a box under my desk. also spare USB-C -> ethernet dongles are saintly
Zoe: poll result: everyone except Sam is prepared :laughing:
Sam: note to self: label cables and hide them from cat. thanks y'all <3
